# Pull Request: OctoAcme Project Management Documentation README

## Description

This pull request adds a comprehensive README for the OctoAcme Project Management Documentation that serves as a central hub for all process documentation.

## What's included

- Comprehensive overview of OctoAcme project management principles and lifecycle
- Well-organized table of contents with links to all documentation files
- Quick reference descriptions for each process document
- Guidance on when and how to use each document
- Onboarding guidance for different personas (PMs, PdMs, Developers, QA)
- Key artifacts reference table
- Feedback and improvement pathways

## Why this is needed

The project management documentation was scattered across individual files in the `docs/` folder. This README:
- Reduces onboarding time for new team members by providing a single entry point
- Improves discoverability of existing processes and guidance
- Creates a structured navigation experience for accessing related documents
- Supports the goal of using these docs as searchable, versioned artifacts in Copilot Spaces
- Establishes a clear taxonomy of OctoAcme's project lifecycle phases
